opportunities.name: GitHub user lead research and hiring email draft
opportunities.description: Search a GitHub username, open the user profile and top repo, then compose a lead email to hiring@example.com with follower count, top repo, stars, language and latest post.
steps: Click GitHub search and type the username
Press Enter and open the Users results tab
Open the top/pinned repository and note stars and language
Open mail compose and enter hiring@example.com as recipient
Write body with followers, top repo, stars, language, latest post
